name: set_text_window_close_transition

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetTextWindowCloseTransition consumes a window ID and preset index and stores it at window descriptor +0x0E; func_0010BB50 maps that preset through D_002B2D18 to the closing countdown consumed by func_0010B810

notes: Known preset indices 0 through 3 select closing countdowns of 0, 4, 8, and 20 ticks.
